title: The Door to the Pass
hook: Hold eastbound. A walker is already in the paint.
scene: Overcast daylight on a two-lane downtown street heading east, wet asphalt edge to edge. The Menace is rolling in the eastbound travel lane — not parked, not stopped in the junction — between the skip-dashed paint and the right curb. The full-width nose plow on the front bull bar points east. Brick downtown blocks run alongside the street on the left, their sidewalks meeting this same roadway. Ahead in the same lane, a person in a dark coat is already in the marked crosswalk, one shoe on the white bars. She is not cleared for the pass. Both cats are a sound in the closed carrier on the floor.
debrief: The Beetle is moving eastbound. Brick blocks share that street on the left. A person is already in the crosswalk. She is not cleared for the pass.

source.teaching_target: Hold eastbound for a person already in the marked crosswalk; brick downtown blocks share the street on the left.
